model: claude-sonnet-5 (Claude Code session, direct image + text-layer read, no Anthropic Messages API call)
method: The source PDF (inputs/incoming/DEICO_DE8208_Technical_Drawing.pdf) was read directly inside a Claude Code conversation, using both the rendered page image and the PDF's embedded text layer, and interpreted by hand against the rules in src/technical_drawing_parser/extraction/prompt.py (build_vlm_prompt) and the schema in product.py, then passed through the real parse_product_json_response and format_json_compact so the final shape matches what the pipeline would produce from that raw response. No API request was made, so this run has no token/API cost beyond the conversation itself and no raw_response.txt equivalent. Because text-layer access is not available to the real image-only VLM call, this file is a hand-derived reference for checking prompt/schema correctness, not a simulation of real Anthropic/Ollama image-only extraction quality.
purpose: Second batch (10 of 41 new samples) of a larger DEICO drawing set staged in outputs_claude_code_sonnet5_test/ for review before promotion to outputs/products/.
